title: Research on heat and mass transfer of PEMEC anode flow channel based on topology optimization
scope: 2D dimensionless steady flow and heat topology model only, Eqs. 1-16

reconstruction_choices.thermal_boundary: T*=0 inlet; zero normal gradient outlet and no-slip walls
reconstruction_choices.port_location: centered on opposing left/right boundaries, interpreted from figures
reconstruction_choices.symmetry: reflect density across horizontal centerline; solve the full square
reconstruction_choices.dimensionless_heat_equation: gamma Re Pr u.grad(T) = laplacian(T) + (1-gamma) H (1-T)
reconstruction_choices.heat_normalization: H treated once as h L^2/k; paper Eqs. 9 and 13 use inconsistent H notation
reconstruction_choices.design_discretization: 16 by 16 cell controls, 128 independent variables with mirror symmetry
reconstruction_choices.baseline: uniform gamma1=0.5; no fixed-fluid cells inside the square
reconstruction_choices.optimizer: existing FlowField black-box algorithms; SNOPT and CFD adjoint not reproduced
reconstruction_choices.numerics: OpenCFD OpenFOAM v2312; SIMPLE, first-order upwind advection, orthogonal diffusion, 2D empty z faces

limitations: Exact Da, H, filter radius and design mesh are unreported.
Published final channel geometry and 65-iteration SNOPT trace are not reproduced.
A converged baseline is not paper validation or mesh independence.
Sharp material layouts should be rechecked on finer meshes; grey density is not a manufactured channel.
